title: Elementary invariance of the ordered Kummer boundary product
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum P and the concrete boundary product of [def-pur-frame-class]. For any scheme X over Spec P.field.k, any natural number c, and tuples f,g of c global functions, suppose g is obtained from f by one unit scaling, a swap of two distinct entries, or a shear f_i -> f_i+a*f_j with i distinct from j. Then their ordered degree-2c boundary products are heterogeneously equal. The generated ideal sheaves agree, so their zero subschemes and the types of these products agree; HEq expresses transport along this equality. No smoothness, regularity or nonzero-divisor hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: For a unit scaling the principal ideal and its complement agree. Kummer additivity writes the new class as the old class plus the restriction of the global Kummer class of the unit. The localization boundary of the latter is zero by exactness. Boundary additivity and cup functoriality leave the full ordered product unchanged.

For adjacent factors, supported associativity and graded symmetry give sign (-1)^(2*2)=1. The symmetry of the rank-one Tate lines preserves their canonical multiplication: locally on a generator it exchanges ae tensor be with be tensor ae. Decompose any transposition into adjacent swaps and reassociate back. Unique isomorphisms of the support intersections identify the result with the same zero subscheme.

For a shear, form f_i+t*a*f_j on A1_X. Subtracting t*a*f_j shows that its total ideal is the constant extension of the original ideal. Construct the boundary product of this tuple on A1_X; boundary and cup naturality identify the zero and unit section pullbacks with the two endpoint products. Supported affine-line invariance makes both section maps inverse to projection pullback, so the endpoint classes agree. The support comparisons are unique over X and coincide with equality transport.
